title: Definition of done: a pinned-number test against an outside source and one seeded mutation before merge
problem: Tests check what the author believed. In 103 of 158 audits (65%, Wilson 57-72%) at least one hand-seeded bug in core logic survived the subject's own tests; untested-core is the largest named defect category (155). Verification fails for 49 of 64 sampled research projects.
evidence: audits with a surviving seeded mutation: 103 of 158 (python3 platform/ci/quality_audit.py metrics --md, 2026-11-10)
verification gate failures among below-bar subjects: 84 of 130
change: Add to the venture and research definition of done: each headline output has a test pinning one value from a source the author did not write (publication table, standard's worked example, hand calculation shown in the test), named in the README; and before merge, seed one mutation in core logic (a small wrapper over prompts/redteam.py --target on the subject's core file) and record whether a test failed in the run record.
metric: share of audits with a surviving seeded mutation
